request: Pull monthly state-level unemployment rates (BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics, series LASST<FIPS>0000000000003) for the 25 most populous states + DC from 2022-2026. Enrich with a rate_band (very_low/low/moderate/elevated/high thresholds on the seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate) plus a state FIPS -> state code lookup. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 21 - BLS LAUS State Unemployment' on Tableau Server for SLED workforce and economic-development analysts.

sources.name: BLS LAUS State Unemployment
sources.description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API v2 - Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS) at the state level. Series ID pattern: LASST<2-digit-state-FIPS>0000000000003 (measure 03 = unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted). Unauth POST caps at 25 series/request and 25 requests/day — this spec fetches the 25 most populous states in a single call. Envelope: {status, Results:{series:[{seriesID, data:[{year, period (M01-M12), periodName, value (string, '-' if missing), footnotes:[{code, text}]}]}]}}.

args.name: Unemployment Trend
args.features_description: Row-level state-monthly unemployment observations with calendar features (year, month, quarter, fiscal_year, day_of_week, iso_week) parsed from obs_date.
args.stats_description: Long-form state-unemployment statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state_fips and rate_band). Includes 12-month rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to spot rate-band shifts or state-level anomalies vs peers.

outputs.name: LAUS State Detail
outputs.description: Row-level monthly state unemployment observations (25 most populous US states, 2022-2026). Fields: seriesID (LASST<FIPS>0000000000003), state_fips (2-digit), year, period (M01-M12), periodName, value (rate %, decimal), obs_date, rate_band (very_low<3.0 / low<4.0 / moderate<5.0 / elevated<6.5 / high). Plus calendar features. Source: BLS Public Data API v2 LAUS. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: LAUS State Stats
outputs.description: Long-form state-unemployment statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state_fips and rate_band). Includes 12-month rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to spot rate-band shifts or state-level anomalies vs peers.
